name: refuse-after-fix-owner-with-balance
description: An after-fix refusal whose fix belongs to the app OWNER, carrying the optional balance the refusing check read. The optional field rides the envelope unchanged — a projector must not drop it, and an agent must not auto-retry a fix it cannot perform.

refusal.message: the balance this deployment funds the app from is exhausted
refusal.fix: the app owner adds funds; the same handshakeId is still valid afterwards
